source: The organization checklist.md and terraform/ build: four members who sign in with email and a password, the owner and the reader with authenticator-app MFA, two custom console roles, six API keys and one Basic service, with seed/seed.sql's database users beside them. ClickHouse Cloud reports when a key was made but the key ages each day, so the roster leaves it out, and the members' last sign-ins are unsettled. The expiring key's expires_in_days is one day before its 2030 expiry would be far enough to stay in range.

owner.case: Created the org at sign-up (checklist step 1). Admin, with authenticator-app MFA.

reader.case: Invited and accepted (checklist step 4). Member and Service reader, with authenticator-app MFA.

auditor.case: Invited and accepted as a Member (checklist step 4). Terraform adds the custom sandbox-auditor role. No MFA.

billing.case: Invited and accepted (checklist step 4). Billing only. No MFA.

admin.name: sandbox-admin
admin.case: Created by hand (checklist step 2) for Terraform and the seed scripts. Admin, no expiry, used every night.

collector.name: epack-collector
collector.case: terraform/main.tf. The collector's key: the custom epack-collector role only, which includes control-plane:organization:manage so the key can list members and console roles. No expiry, usable from anywhere, used every night.

auditor.name: sandbox-auditor
auditor.case: terraform/main.tf. The custom sandbox-auditor role. Never used.

expiring.name: sandbox-expiring
expiring.case: terraform/main.tf. Expires at the start of 2030, with no roles.

ip_limited.name: sandbox-ip-limited
ip_limited.case: terraform/main.tf. Usable only from 203.0.113.0/24, a documentation range, so never used. No roles.

pending.case: Never accepted. before-collect.sh creates it again whenever it is missing or expires within a day.

service.name: epack-sandbox
service.case: terraform/main.tf. One Basic service that idles after 5 minutes. before-collect.sh opens it to the current runner only.

default.case: Created with the service. default_role. Its password is SANDBOX_CLICKHOUSE_DEFAULT_PASSWORD.

epack_collector.case: seed/seed.sql. The collector's read-only user: role access_reader and readonly = 1.

ops_admin.case: seed/seed.sql. A password that expires at the start of 2030, and role user_admin WITH ADMIN OPTION.

deploy_bot.case: seed/seed.sql. SSH key only, no roles.

legacy_app.case: seed/seed.sql. A password and an SSH key, either enough to sign in, and SELECT on app.events WITH GRANT OPTION.

office_only.case: seed/seed.sql. Password, allowed only from 10.0.0.0/8, role app_reader.

cloud_managed.case: Made by ClickHouse Cloud, not seed.sql, as of 2026-11-12. Cloud's own users are the ones stored in users_xml; default and sql-console are stored in replicated like the customer's users. Cloud can change the users_xml list without a new service version, so the expectations only require at least one of them. Cloud's roles are stored in replicated too, so only their names tell them apart.

roles.access_reader: SHOW ACCESS as far as the default user holds it, plus SELECT on system.grants, system.role_grants, system.settings_profile_elements, and system.quota_limits.
roles.app_reader: SELECT on app.*, with the ro_profile settings profile, the reader_quota quota, and the tenant_a row policy.
roles.user_admin: CREATE USER, ALTER USER, DROP USER, and ROLE ADMIN on *.*, as far as the default user holds them. Cloud withholds them on its own sql-console users.
